How much to invest in a factory to maximize production?

NOTE THAT the argmax is infinity. This is not a good model of the situation. It's not production so much as profit that needs maximizing.

Cobb Douglass production function 

Just saying how much to produce to minimize the unit cost is an incomplete objective function.
